description: This class `HomeActivity` is an Android activity that handles the main interface of a weather app. It manages UI components, user interactions (like city search and voice input), network requests to fetch weather data, and app update checks.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the weather app UI, user interactions, and network data fetching.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, sets listeners, and initiates data fetch.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from voice input recognition, initiating city search.

methods.name: setNavigationBarColor
methods.description: Sets the navigation bar color for devices Lollipop and above.

methods.name: setUpDaysRecyclerView
methods.description: Configures the recycler view for displaying daily weather forecast.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Sets up UI event listeners for touch, click, and keyboard actions.

methods.name: setRefreshLayoutColor
methods.description: Sets color scheme for the refresh layout animation.

methods.name: searchCity
methods.description: Initiates weather data fetch for the specified city name.

methods.name: getDataUsingNetwork
methods.description: Obtains current location and triggers weather data fetch.

methods.name: setLatitudeLongitudeUsingCity
methods.description: Fetches coordinate data for a city and subsequently updates weather info.

methods.name: getTodayWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches current weather data for a location and updates UI.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI elements with fetched weather data.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates day names to local language.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the progress indicator and reveals main layout.

methods.name: hideMainLayout
methods.description: Shows progress indicator and hides main layout.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity and fetches data or shows error.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles user's response to location permission request.

methods.name: checkUpdate
methods.description: Checks for app updates and initiates immediate update if available.
